note: SYNTHETIC. Fictional telco 'Meridian Mobile' — not a real company. No real customer data.

ground_truth.earliest_intervention_action: On contact 1 the agent should have confirmed which service the customer meant before cancelling anything — the customer asked to cancel the tablet plan and the mobile was cancelled instead
ground_truth.why_this_scenario_exists: 根因是「需求被误解」：客服执行得很快、很热情，但把客户的诉求听错了——客户要停平板的套餐，结果手机号被停了。承诺没有违背，动作也做了，但做错了。用来测系统能否区分「做了动作」和「做对了动作」。

contacts.summary: Customer asks to cancel the tablet data plan. Agent cancels the mobile service instead.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I've got two services with you — my mobile and a data plan for my tablet. I'd like to cancel the tablet one, I never use it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: No problem at all, I can sort that out for you right now.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That's cancelled and confirmed. You'll see it drop off the next bill.

needs.summary: Cancel the tablet data plan, keep the mobile

evidence.speaker: customer
evidence.quote: I'd like to cancel the tablet one, I never use it

actions.summary: Cancelled a service without confirming which one the customer meant

contacts.summary: Customer's mobile is dead. The wrong service was cancelled. Restoring it needs a new order.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: My mobile stopped working overnight. I rang yesterday to cancel the tablet plan, not my phone.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Oh — I can see it. The mobile service was the one closed off. I'm very sorry.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I've missed calls all morning. I run my business off this number.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Reconnecting means raising a new order, it isn't something I can just switch back on.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And the tablet plan I actually asked about?

actions.summary: Confirmed the wrong service had been cancelled

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: The mobile service was the one closed off.
